annotations.title: List Ahrefs Rank Tracker + Site Audit projects

description: Every Rank Tracker AND Site Audit project the caller's connected Ahrefs Connect grant can access — the data source for picking which project(s) to bind to a MisarSEO project (see set_ahrefs_project). Live call to the Ahrefs API v3 under the caller's OWN OAuth token. Read-only and FREE (no credits). Check `requiresReconnect` before treating both lists as 'no projects': true means the stored grant can no longer reach Ahrefs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_ahrefs_projects
